form.openfluxNote: OpenFlux exit. One link, one active client. New user = new inbound (own port and carrier URL). Direct uses this inbound port. Paste Yandex, Volga, Board, Telemost, Mail.ru, Cups or Avito URLs for extra carriers; several links of one carrier form a group. Volga, Board, Telemost, Avito and l3 need OpenFlux v0.13 or newer: the Better OpenFlux plugin installs it. Upload the binary on Settings → Cores.
form.openfluxExitModeHint: l4 works everywhere and needs no extra rules. l3 forwards raw packets (faster, Linux root only): the panel adds an iptables rule that drops the RSTs the server itself sends from its address, so its closed ports look filtered. Chosen on creation; changing it restarts the exit.
form.openfluxUrlHint: Optional. Several links: one per line or separated by commas (they form one group). No # or ; in a link — the exit config parser cuts those.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.subtitle: Extend the panel with plugins from GitHub. Each plugin lives in its own folder and never modifies panel files; removing it restores the panel to its previous state.
plugins.disabledBySwitch: The plugin system is turned off by the XUI_PLUGINS_DISABLED environment variable. Remove it and restart the panel to use plugins.
plugins.loadFailed: Could not load the plugin list.
plugins.trustWarning: A plugin is third-party code. Install only plugins from authors you trust and read the permissions before confirming.
plugins.runNotice: Process plugins run as separate systemd services under a restricted user. Restarting the panel does not stop them.
plugins.runNoticeProcess: Process plugins run as unprivileged child processes of the panel, each under its own user. Restarting the panel restarts them.

isolation.partial: Plugins here run under their own unprivileged users, but this host cannot filter their outgoing connections or hide files that every user can read. The network permission is not enforced.
isolation.weak: Plugin processes on this host do not get their own user and are not network-filtered, so they are not isolated from the panel. Use this for development only.
isolation.previewNoNetwork: This plugin did not ask for the network permission, but this host cannot block its network access.

perm.network: Can reach the internet from the server.
perm.apiRead: Can read panel data through the panel API.
perm.apiWrite: Can change panel data through the panel API.
perm.pipeline: Can alter data the panel produces (for example Xray config or subscription links).
perm.uiMenu: Adds entries to the sidebar menu.
perm.seam: Can take part in how the panel answers requests, and see or change them (including what clients receive).

plugins.alreadyInstalled: This plugin is already installed. Uninstall it first to install another version.
plugins.author: Author
plugins.dangerousWarning: This plugin requests dangerous permissions (marked red). Install it only if you fully trust its author.
plugins.accept: I reviewed the permissions and want to install this plugin
plugins.uninstallBody: The plugin's files are deleted and the panel stops using it.
plugins.mirrorDesc: Plugins are downloaded from codeload.github.com. If your server cannot reach it, set a mirror that serves <base>/<owner>/<repo>/tar.gz/<ref>. Leave empty for the default.
plugins.processesUnavailable: Plugin processes cannot run on this system ({error}). Plugins can still be installed; their interface pages work.
plugins.masterDesc: When this panel is a node of another LucX panel, that master can install and control plugins here, but only if you allow it. The node downloads the plugin itself from the pinned commit and refuses anything that differs from what the master approved. The master can only control plugins it installed; those you installed by hand stay yours.
plugins.masterWarning: A master panel can now run third-party code on this server through plugins. Allow it only for a master you control.
plugins.masterSwitch: Allow the master panel to manage plugins on this node

nodes.title: Plugins on nodes
nodes.desc: Install and control plugins on your nodes. A node downloads the plugin itself, at the exact version installed on this panel, and only if its owner allowed management by the master. Nothing is updated automatically.
nodes.install: Install a plugin on this node
nodes.nothingToInstall: Every plugin that can run on nodes is already installed here.
nodes.installNote: The node downloads this exact version itself and refuses it if anything differs. The plugin is installed disabled.
nodes.accept: I reviewed the permissions and allow {node} to run this plugin
nodes.managementOff: Management by this panel is off on the node
nodes.driftHint: The node runs a different version than this panel. Use Update on node to match it.

update.title: Update {name} on {node}
update.note: The plugin is removed from the node and installed again at this panel's version. It is stopped for a moment, its data is kept, and there is no automatic way back: if the new version cannot be installed, the node is left without the plugin.
update.accept: I accept the added permissions on {node}

frame.unavailable: This plugin page is not available
frame.unavailableHint: The plugin may be disabled or removed.
frame.replacedBanner: This page is replaced by the plugin {name}.

update.title: Update {name}
update.typeChanged: The plugin type changes from {from} to {to}.
update.scopeChanged: The plugin scope changes from {from} to {to}.
update.accept: I accept the added permissions and changes
update.restartNote: A running plugin is restarted. If the new version is not healthy within 30 seconds, the previous one is restored. The plugin's data is kept.

rollback.title: Roll back {name}?
rollback.body: Go back to version {version} ({commit}). The plugin's data is kept and the newer version is dropped.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.desc: Plugins reviewed and listed in the signed catalog. A plugin is installed exactly at the commit the catalog signed.
catalog.idConflict: A different plugin with this id is installed.
catalog.unconfigured: This panel has no catalog signing key, so the catalog is off. Plugins can still be installed from a link.
catalog.error: The catalog could not be loaded: {error}
catalog.sourceDesc: The catalog is fetched from this address. A mirror can serve the catalog but cannot change it: the signature is checked against the panel's own keys. Leave empty for the default.
catalog.unlisted: This commit is not in the signed catalog: nobody has reviewed this code. Install it only if you trust its author.
catalog.notPublished: The catalog has not been published yet. Plugins can still be installed from a link.

system.title: Plugin system
system.desc: The service that installs and runs plugins. It updates on its own: the panel, your plugins and VPN connections keep running while it restarts.
system.upToDate: The plugin system is up to date.
system.confirmBody: The service downloads the signed release, verifies it and restarts. Plugin pages are unavailable for a few seconds; the panel, running plugins and VPN connections are not affected. If the new release fails to start, the previous one is restored.
system.restarting: Updating to {version}. Waiting for the plugin system to come back…
system.updated: The plugin system was updated to {version}
system.rolledBack: {version} did not start properly and was rolled back to the previous release.
system.timeout: The plugin system did not come back in time. Check the service on the server.

seamModeHint.before: Looks at or changes the request before the panel handles it, or answers it itself.
seamModeHint.after: Changes the answer the panel gave.
